scripts.test: sh -c 'f=$(gofmt -l .); [ -z "$f" ] || { echo "gofmt: $f"; exit 1; }' && go vet -tags e2e,privylive,loadtest,mainnetfork ./... && sh scripts/with-env.sh go test -race -count=1 ./...
scripts.loadtest: sh scripts/with-env.sh go test -tags e2e,loadtest -run TestLoad -count=1 -v -timeout 60m ./e2e/ -args
